text: RemoteLink 是面向 DSH Web 的手机远程控制插件：它在 Web 设置和侧栏加入配对界面，由桌面端生成一次性二维码，手机扫码后进入同一套响应式 DSH 页面。插件支持刷新或停止配对、查看设备在线状态、选择局域网地址或配置公网入口，也可启用 Cloudflare 快速隧道供异地访问；任务完成时还能在桌面和手机页面提示并播放提示音。适合希望在手机上继续使用桌面 DSH 会话的用户。自动公网隧道会把本机 Web 服务经 Cloudflare 公网入口提供访问；使用前无需 API 密钥。

RemoteLink pairs phones with DSH Web using a desktop QR code. It adds pairing controls and device status to Web settings and opens the responsive interface on phones. Users can refresh or stop pairing, select a LAN address, or set a public URL. An optional Cloudflare tunnel enables remote access.
想用手机扫码接着操作电脑上运行的 DSH Web。
能不能生成一个临时二维码，让手机加入当前的 DSH 会话？
I want to pair my phone with the DSH web client using a QR code.
RemoteLink 的功能「手机扫码配对」：在 Web 设置面板生成一次性二维码，手机扫码后绑定设备并打开 DSH Web；可刷新二维码、停止配对或查看在线设备状态。
RemoteLink 的功能「任务完成提醒」：当 DSH 会话中的 agent 完成一轮任务时，在打开的桌面和手机页面显示提示并播放短音效；系统通知需浏览器授权。
RemoteLink 使用自动公网隧道时会经 Cloudflare quick tunnel 提供本机 Web 服务的公网访问地址；该选项默认关闭。

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink
```

Restart `dsh web` after the add succeeds. This repository ships prebuilt `lib/`.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink README · Use：1. Open the desktop GUI at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (the pairing panel is loopback-only).
2. Settings → Remote: turn the plugin on and save.
3. Scan the QR (or open the copied link) on the phone. The phone binds and reloads into the normal web UI (the sidebar/details collapse automatically on small screens).
4. **Stop** revokes every paired device. **Refresh** invalidates the current QR.

The sidebar chip **正在远程操控** appears only while at least one paired phone is online.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink README · Task-complete alerts：When an agent goes idle after running, the desktop GUI and an open phone tab play a short chime and show a system notification (after the browser grants permission). Settings → Remote → **任务完成提醒** toggles this on both sides. Keep the web UI open on the phone; Android Chrome can still banner while the tab is in the background. The notification body is the session title only — never an origin or path.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink README · Public access (own domain)：Leave **自动公网隧道** off. Point a reverse proxy or named tunnel at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`, then set **公网地址** to that origin, for example `https://dsh.example.com`. Save and refresh the QR; pick **公网地址**, not a LAN IP.

Also trust that host on the connection plugin (`--trusted-host dsh.example.com`, or a profile overlay that concatenates it onto `ctx.webRuntime.trustedHosts`).

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-remotelink README · Public access (own domain)：A Cloudflare *quick* tunnel hostname changes every run and does not forward SSE; chat then polls. A stable hostname on your own domain avoids that churn.
